results.content: VLO6041 - Educational Leadership and Emotional Intelligence in Virtual Learning Institutions (3 credits) This course provides a comprehensive overview of the importance of leadership and its relationship with emotional intelligence applied in educational institutions, providing the foundation for identifying potential tools to develop the skills and competencies of a leader and thus generate improvements in the teaching process for the benefit of students. 185 ADMINISTRATIVE STAFF DIRECTORY • Ferran Calatayud: CEO & Chief Executive Officer • Sandra Mendoza de Verde: Academic Dean, Research Dean • José Luis Córica: Academic Director • Luis Jose Torres Morales: University Registrar and Student Care Director • Dayana Chacón: Financial Director • Eduardo Atencio: Professional Development Director • Olga Mar Gonzalez de Leon: Compliance Officer 186 ADJUNCT FACULTY DIRECTORY SCHOOL OF BUSINESS Alberto Merced Castro Valencia --- School of Business Full-time Professor and Researcher at the National Technological Institute of Mexico in the fields of international economics and finance, teaching both undergraduate and graduate courses, Member of the National Researchers System of the National Council for Science and Technology, and thesis advisor for master's and doctoral students.
